name: FFS_SCHEDULING_PLAN
description: Contains a full list of configured routing plans.

columns.name: SCHEDULING_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the scheduling plan.

columns.name: SCHEDULING_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the scheduling profile. The foreign key to the table FFS_SCHEDULING_PROFILE.

columns.name: PREDECESSOR_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the scheduling plan that comes prior the SCHEDULING_PLAN_ID if they launched sequentially.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Scheduling plan name which is defined by the customer.

columns.name: ACTIVE
columns.description: Actual Status Of The Scheduling Plan. The Field Contains 1 For Active Scheduling Plan And 0 For Plans That Have To Be Skipped If There Is The Sequence Plan Starting, Ignored If It Is The Automatic Starting And Prevented If It Is The Manual Starting.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Mode how the run of the scheduling plan has to be launched. If the field is 'automatic' it means that the runs of the plan are started automatically, but value 'manual' means the run has to be initiated by customer from GUI.

columns.name: GOAL_BASED_OPTIMIZATION
columns.description: Optimization goal that is chosen by the customer.

columns.name: START_DAY_OFFSET
columns.description: Start Day Offset For Activity Processing Regarding The Route Date. The Field Makes Sense For Scheduling Plans That Start Automatically.

columns.name: FROM_TIME
columns.description: In the case of the recurrent or immediate scheduling plan it is the time within configured days of weeks when the series of recurrent runs has to begin. In the case of a single run it is just the start time. The time is measured in minutes regarding the midnight. For example, 600 means 10 AM.

columns.name: TO_TIME
columns.description: Time within configured days of week when the series of runs has to end. The field makes sense for recurrent and immediate runs. The time is measured in minutes regarding the midnight. For example, 1080 means 6 PM.

columns.name: INTERVAL
columns.description: Time interval between launching of recurrent scheduling runs of the plan, minutes. If it is set to 5, it means that a new scheduling run will be launched every 5 minutes. The field is empty for non recurrent scheduling plans.

columns.name: WEEKDAYS
columns.description: Bit Mask For Days Of Week When The Routing Plan Has To Be Launched.

columns.name: TIME_LIMIT
columns.description: Time Limit For A Scheduling Run Duration, Seconds.

columns.name: AUTO_ORDERING
columns.description: Defines the behaviour of not-ordered activities.

columns.name: UNIFORMITY_COEFF
columns.description: Boolean coefficient to activate the uniform activity assignment 'Try to schedule activities to service window start'.

columns.name: FITNESS_COEFF_WINDOW_RESERV
columns.description: Deprecated. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: DYNAMIC_SCHED_TIME
columns.description: Parameter of the dynamic scheduling 'Resources loading interval, minutes'.

columns.name: DYNAMIC_SCHED_NUM_ACTIVITIES
columns.description: Parameter of the dynamic scheduling 'Resources loading amount, activities'.

columns.name: DYNAMIC_SCHED_STOP_CONDITION
columns.description: Parameter of the dynamic scheduling 'Stop loading when'. It has two possible values 'any limit is exceeded' and 'both limits are exceeded'.

columns.name: HOME_ZONE_OVERSTEP_WGHT
columns.description: Weight coefficient for the home zone overstep. It is used by the optimisation engine to prevent field resources to leave their home zones.

columns.name: UPDATED
columns.description: Timestamp when the scheduling plan was updated last time.

columns.name: RESOURCE_OVERTIME
columns.description: Maximal allowed overtime for all field resources within the scheduling plan.

columns.name: UNACCEPTABLE_TRAVEL_TIME
columns.description: Maximal allowed travel time between two neighbouring locations in a route. It is a constraint for activity assignment.

columns.name: UNACCEPTABLE_TRAVEL_DISTANCE
columns.description: Maximal allowed distance between two neighbouring locations in a route. It is a constraint for activity assignment.

columns.name: TRAVEL_OPTIMIZATION_STRATEGY
columns.description: Strategy of travel optimization: to minimize either travel time or travel distance.

columns.name: USE_SLT
columns.description: Boolean flag that allows using the SLT-service to obtain travel data.

columns.name: LIMIT_WORK_BY_POINTS
columns.description: Boolean flag if routes have to be limited by points.

columns.name: DEFAULT_APPT_POINTS
columns.description: Deprecated. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: APPT_POINTS_PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Deprecated field. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: GET_TECH_POINTS_FROM_CALENDAR
columns.description: Deprecated. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: DEFAULT_TECH_POINTS
columns.description: Deprecated. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: TECH_POINTS_PROPERTYID
columns.description: Deprecated. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: CALENDAR_POINT_SIZE
columns.description: Deprecated field. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: CALENDAR_RESERVED
columns.description: Deprecated field. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: ASSURANCE_STILL_LIMIT
columns.description: Deprecated field. Will be removed soon.

columns.name: INSUFFICIENT_SKILL_FACTOR
columns.description: Additional multiplier for the ratio between actual and preferred skill levels. It affects the relevance cost of activity assignment.

columns.name: DEFAULT_HOME_ZONE_RADIUS
columns.description: Defines the size of the home zone as the radius regarding the home zone center. In turn the home zone center has to be defined for every field resource separately.

columns.name: HOME_ZONE_ENABLE
columns.description: Enables home zone restrictions while scheduling.

columns.name: USE_REQUIRED_INVENTORY
columns.description: Enables the scheduling engine to consider required inventory for activity assignment.

columns.name: REOPT_ENABLE
columns.description: Enables reoptimization for preassigned activities.

columns.name: REOPT_GOAL
columns.description: Re-optimization goal. By default the goal is 'optimize routes'.

columns.name: REOPT_REDUCE_OVERDUE_THOLD
columns.description: Parameter 'Preferable overall reduction of activities overdue value, %' for the optimization goal 'Reduce activity overdue'. The result of the optimization is applied if the total overdue for such kind of activities is decreased by the value.

columns.name: TRIGGER_FILTER_ID
columns.description: Parameter of the immediate scheduling. Scheduling will be performed immediately when the activity that corresponds to the selected filter is detected on the bucket.

columns.name: IMMEDIATE_SCHEDULING_TYPE
columns.description: Parameter of the immediate scheduling. Possible values are 'Urgent', 'Scheduled' and 'Continuous'.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_FROM
columns.description: Starting day of multiday scheduling relatively to the route_date. It is not configurable, is set automatically and usually equals to zero.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_TO
columns.description: Number of days for the multiday scheduling.

columns.name: BUNDLING_FROM
columns.description: Makes sense for immediate plans of 'Scheduled type. Fields BUNDLING_FROM and. BUNDLING_TO define the time interval in days within which an activity can be scheduled and bundled to a suitable day.

columns.name: BUNDLING_TO
columns.description: Both fields BUNDLING_FROM and. BUNDLING_TO define the time interval in days within which an activity can be scheduled and bundled to a suitable day.

columns.name: REOPT_MOVE_COST_OVERRIDE
columns.description: Allows override default moving activities penalty.

columns.name: REOPT_MOVE_COST
columns.description: Size of the penalty for moving activities.

columns.name: SW_RESERVATION_OVERRIDE
columns.description: Allows overriding the default value SW_RESERVATION.

columns.name: SW_RESERVATION
columns.description: Reserved part of Service Window from its end where activity assignment is not desired.

columns.name: IMMEDIATE_SCHEDULING_SUBTYPE
columns.description: Parameter of the immediate scheduling for activity assignment. It points at the automatic assignment or at the assignment via collaboration.

columns.name: COLLAB_ROUTING_TIME_LIMIT
columns.description: In the case of the assignment via collaboration it is the interval for users to accept the activity, minutes.

columns.name: FLOW_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the message scenario that should be run if an immediate assignment times out or fails. It is the foreign key to the table FFS_MESSAGE_FLOW.

columns.name: SCHEDULING_TO_CONTRACTOR
columns.description: Boolean flag which defines if the assignment to contractor's resource is allowed or activities have Ito be moved to the bucket instead of the assignment to contractor's resource.

columns.name: ONLY_INTERNAL_RESOURCES
columns.description: Boolean flag restricts the use resources outside the routing bucket.

columns.name: IGNORE_WORK_ZONE_MISMATCH
columns.description: Indicates whether the immediate scheduling may ignore work zone mismatch assigning activities.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Scheduling plan description provided by customer.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_TYPE_ID_INV_PICKUP
columns.description: Identifier of an activity type which will be used as a template to create warehouse visits.

columns.name: TIME_LIMIT_PERCENT_SLT
columns.description: Time limit for SLT-service as percents from total scheduling plan time limit.

columns.name: TARGET_QUALITY
columns.description: Target value of the expected assignment quality, percents.

columns.name: RECOMM_MIN_TIME_LIMIT
columns.description: Minimal recommended time limit for scheduling plan, seconds.

columns.name: RECOMM_MAX_TIME_LIMIT
columns.description: Maximal (the best) recommended time limit for scheduling plan, seconds.

columns.name: RECOMM_BALANCED_TIME_LIMIT
columns.description: Balanced recommended time limit for scheduling plan, seconds.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Scheduling plan label provided by customer.

columns.name: INVENTORY_REQUIRED_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days prior to the activity date that inventory is required. A value of 0 indicates that inventory is required for all days.

columns.name: DAILY_DISTANCE_LIMIT_IS_USED
columns.description: Is daily travel distance limitation applied.

columns.name: UNACCEPTABLE_DAILY_DISTANCE
columns.description: Daily travel distance limitation in Scheduling, km.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).

columns.name: FLAGS
columns.description: It is a bitmask field that defines scheduling plan flags.
